title: DecisionResponse
description: Envelope a participant agent returns before deadline_utc. Structural validation happens at receipt; semantic validation later applies the Competition engine's reject-not-repair policy and records violations for M9.

team_id.description: Optional compatibility metadata only. Authentication comes from the API key; if supplied this value must match the authenticated team.

target_weights.description: Ticker -> target weight. Numeric and finite. Cash is implicit: cash_weight = 1 - sum(target_weights). A semantically invalid vector is rejected as a whole and is never clipped or rescaled.
